title: AIAS Cloud-Neutral Autonomous Engineering Control Plane
purpose: Materialize secure, recoverable and tenant-isolated autonomous engineering job control without unauthorized external provisioning.
scope: Tenants, principals, quotas, jobs, fair scheduling, trusted workers, leases, recovery, content-addressed artifacts, integrity and audit chain.

requirements.title: Tenant isolation
requirements.statement: Jobs and artifacts shall require tenant-scoped principal authorization and namespaces.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Resource governance
requirements.statement: Queued, running and artifact consumption shall respect explicit tenant quotas.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reliable scheduling
requirements.statement: Compatible jobs shall be fairly scheduled through trusted expiring worker leases and recoverable attempts.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Artifact integrity
requirements.statement: Artifacts shall be immutable, content-addressed, quota-bound and tenant-isolated.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Immediate consumer
requirements.statement: A Lighthouse AEOS operating job shall lease, store evidence and complete through the cloud-neutral control plane.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: Cloud control plane shall include tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
